br_chicken_kiev_wedges.title: Chicken Kiev
br_chicken_kiev_wedges.author: Nagi Maehashi
br_chicken_kiev_wedges.note: Uses the recipe's own no-fry option (pre-toasted panko, oven-baked) instead of deep-frying; dried herbs + lemon zest stand in for parsley; wedges and broccoli added.

br_gammon_egg_chips.title: Gammon Egg and Chips with Pineapple and Tomato
br_gammon_egg_chips.author: Brian Jones
br_gammon_egg_chips.note: Home-cut oven chips instead of frozen; tomato dropped; pineapple optional.

br_fish_finger_sandwiches.title: Homemade Fish Finger Sandwich with Tartare Sauce
br_fish_finger_sandwiches.note: Panko crumb without parmesan; sliced bread instead of ciabatta; scaled to 2. Cross-checked against Tesco Real Food posh fish-finger sandwiches (https://realfood.tesco.com/recipes/posh-fish-finger-sandwiches.html).

br_sausage_rolls_beans_wedges.title: Sausage rolls
br_sausage_rolls_beans_wedges.author: Jamie Oliver
br_sausage_rolls_beans_wedges.note: Dried mixed herbs for fresh sage, panko for breadcrumbs, nutmeg dropped, quicker onion; baked beans and wedges added to make a dinner.

br_roast_pork_crackling.title: Pork Roast with Crispy Crackling
br_roast_pork_crackling.author: Nagi Maehashi
br_roast_pork_crackling.note: Source is a 3kg shoulder roasted low then blasted; scaled to a small UK crackling joint (high heat first, then 180°C fan) with roast potatoes, apple sauce and gravy.

br_steak_ale_pie_mash.title: Steak and Ale Pie
br_steak_ale_pie_mash.author: The Hairy Bikers
br_steak_ale_pie_mash.note: Scaled to 2 (400g beef); mushrooms left out; braise lengthened to 1½ h for casserole steak; puff pastry lid as in the source; mash and broccoli added.

br_lancashire_hotpot.title: Lancashire Hotpot
br_lancashire_hotpot.note: Diced lamb leg instead of chops, kidneys and mint omitted, carrot added; scaled to 2 with shorter bake times.

br_chicken_chorizo_traybake.title: Chicken and chorizo traybake
br_chicken_chorizo_traybake.note: White potatoes for sweet potatoes, thigh fillets for bone-in pieces, chorizo chunks for chorizo meatballs, cherry tomatoes added; spinach and honey finish kept.

br_corned_beef_hash_eggs.title: Corned beef hash with eggs
br_corned_beef_hash_eggs.note: Same ingredients and method scaled to 2; potatoes cubed rather than grated; spring onions for parsley.
